meta.about: Held-out evaluation set for the PG regulations build. Run with: python evaluate.py eval_pg.json pg
meta.grading: Do NOT trust the raw string-match score alone - read the FAILs. Many are correct answers that trip a must_not term (e.g. the answer says 'Fail grade' and trips a forbidden 'F'), or expected a figure phrased differently. The mechanical score is a proxy; the real score is by MEANING. Grade each answer against the clause it comes from.
meta.source: NIT Durgapur PG Regulations (MTech/MCA/MBA/MSc/MSW), up to 69th Senate (23.01.2023).

buckets.PG-APP: Single-fact lookups from the grade table (Appendix-II), SGPA/CGPA rules (Appendix-III), supplementary grade map (Appendix-IV) and class thresholds.
buckets.PG-PAR: Paraphrased clause questions - attendance, exam, leave, duration, admission.
buckets.PG-OOS: Out of scope - not in the regulations; the bot should decline and point to the Academic Section, not invent a figure.
buckets.PG-PART: Completeness - the answer must include every item in a list, not just an example.
buckets.PG-MT: Multi-turn - the final answer is scored; tests carrying context without confusing adjacent facts.

turns: I scored 72 in a theory subject. What letter grade and grade point do I get?
cases.grading_note: 70-79 -> B, grade point 8.

turns: What grade and grade point correspond to 88 marks in a theory course?
cases.grading_note: 80-89 -> A, grade point 9. Letter A is not forbidden-checked because 'a' collides with the article.

turns: I got 55 marks. What is my grade and grade points?
cases.grading_note: 50-59 -> D, grade point 6.

turns: What grade is 40 marks in a theory paper, and how many grade points?
cases.grading_note: 35-49 -> P (Pass), grade point 5. P is the lowest pass grade.

turns: I scored 30 in a theory subject. What grade is that?
cases.grading_note: Below 35 -> F, grade point 0.

turns: What grade and grade point does 95 marks earn?
cases.grading_note: 90 and above -> Ex, grade point 10.

turns: Below what mark is a theory paper given an F grade?
cases.grading_note: Cut-off for F in theory papers is 35 (Appendix-II).

turns: What is the cut-off mark below which a sessional paper is failed (F grade)?
cases.grading_note: Cut-off for F in sessional papers is 50 (Appendix-II).

turns: If I scored a B and clear the subject in the supplementary examination, what grade gets recorded?
cases.grading_note: Supplementary grade is one letter lower, not below P: B -> C (Appendix-IV).

turns: If my supplementary result works out to a P, is it reduced any further?
cases.grading_note: Reduction is 'not below P', so P stays P (Appendix-IV).

turns: What is the maximum possible SGPA or CGPA?
cases.grading_note: Maximum possible SGPA and CGPA is 10.00 (Appendix-III).

turns: What CGPA do I need for a First Class?
cases.grading_note: First Class: CGPA equal to or more than 6.50 (Clause 11.4).

turns: What CGPA range counts as Second Class?
cases.grading_note: Second Class: CGPA 5.00 or more but less than 6.50 (Clause 11.4).

turns: What is the minimum CGPA required to be awarded the PG degree?
cases.grading_note: Graduation needs CGPA 5.00 or higher and minimum grade P in every subject (Clause 13.1).

turns: What transitional grade symbol is used when a student is absent?
cases.grading_note: X = Absent (Appendix-III). I is not forbidden-checked ('I' collides with the pronoun).

turns: What does an 'I' grade mean?
cases.grading_note: I = Incomplete assessment (Appendix-III).

turns: How is CGPA converted to percentage of marks?
cases.grading_note: % of Marks = (CGPA - 0.5) x 10.00 (Appendix-III).

turns: My attendance in a theory course is 60%. What happens to my grade?
cases.grading_note: 60% is <75% but not <50% -> reduction of one grade (Clause 9.7).

turns: What happens if my attendance in a course is below 25%?
cases.grading_note: Attendance <25% -> debarred from the end-semester examination (Clause 9.7).

turns: How long is the end-term examination?
cases.grading_note: End-term exam duration is 3 hours / 180 minutes (Clause 11.2h). '180' also acceptable.

turns: What is the duration of the mid-term examination?
cases.grading_note: Mid-term exam is 1.5 hours / 90 minutes (Clause 11.2h). '1.5 hours' also acceptable.

turns: How many days of leave is a PG scholarship holder allowed in a year?
cases.grading_note: PG students with scholarship: maximum 30 days of leave in a calendar year (Clause 10.1).

turns: What percentage weightage does the end-term examination carry in a theory course?
cases.grading_note: Theory course weightage: CA 15%, Mid-term 25%, End-term 60% (Clause 11.2f).

turns: What is the maximum permissible duration, in semesters, to finish the M.Tech programme?
cases.grading_note: M.Tech: normal 4 semesters, maximum permissible 6 (Clause 13.3 table).

turns: What is the maximum permissible number of semesters for the MCA programme?
cases.grading_note: MCA: normal 6 semesters, maximum permissible 8 (Clause 13.3 table).

turns: What qualifying test score is mandatory for admission to the MBA programme?
cases.grading_note: A qualifying CAT/MAT/XAT score is mandatory for MBA admission (Clause 2.3d).

turns: What happens if I fail to appear in the end-term examination of a subject?
cases.grading_note: Declared 'Failed' in that subject and permitted supplementary with a penalty of one letter grade, not below P (Clause 12.3c).

turns: An M.Tech student converts to off-campus mode after recruitment. Over how many semesters can they complete the final-year project?
cases.grading_note: Such students may complete the final-year project in four semesters instead of two, paying Institute fees each semester (Clause 13.3).

turns: For remedial classes, what is the minimum number of registered students required per course?
cases.grading_note: Remedial classes need a minimum of 10 students per course; maximum 20 class hours (Clause 12.16).

turns: What is the Wi-Fi password for the PG hostel?
cases.grading_note: Out of scope. The bot should say this is not in the regulations and point to the Academic Section, not invent a password.

turns: What was the average placement salary for M.Tech students last year?
cases.grading_note: Out of scope. No placement figures are in the regulations; the bot should decline rather than quote a number.

turns: Who is the current Head of the Mechanical Engineering department?
cases.grading_note: Out of scope. The regulations name roles, not current office holders; the bot should decline, not name a person.

turns: Exactly how many rupees is the PG tuition fee per semester?
cases.grading_note: Out of scope. Fees are 'as prescribed from time to time', no rupee figure is in the regulations; the bot should decline, not invent an amount.

turns: List all the assessment components and their weightage for a theory course.
cases.grading_note: Must include ALL three: Continuous Assessment 15%, Mid-term 25%, End-term 60% (Clause 11.2f). Missing any one is an incomplete answer.

turns: What are the normal and maximum permissible durations, in semesters, for the MCA programme?
cases.grading_note: Both figures required: normal 6 semesters, maximum 8 (Clause 13.3 table).

turns: I scored 85 in a theory paper. What grade is that?
And how many grade points does that carry?
cases.grading_note: 80-89 -> A (turn 1), grade point 9 (turn 2). Final answer scored; tests carrying the grade across turns.

turns: What is the minimum CGPA needed to be awarded the degree?
And what CGPA do I need for First Class?
cases.grading_note: Turn 1 = 5.00 (graduation), turn 2 = 6.50 (First Class). Final answer must give 6.50 and must NOT repeat 5.00 - the two thresholds must not be confused (Clauses 13.1, 11.4).

turns: I got a B in a course but I want to improve it through the supplementary examination.
If I score an A in that supplementary, what grade will finally be recorded?
cases.grading_note: Supplementary grade is one letter lower, not below P: an A in the supplementary is recorded as B (Appendix-IV). Forbidden left empty on purpose - forbidding 'A' would collide with the article 'a' and false-FAIL every run; judge by meaning that the final grade is B, not A.
